templates.name: Cognipeer Sandbox (Python · Node · git)
templates.description: Single batteries-included image: Python 3.12, Node.js 22, git, curl/wget, jq, ripgrep, build tools. Good default for most agent work. Add your own template for anything special.

templates.name: Web app + browser testing
templates.description: Playwright + Chromium + ffmpeg on top of the base image. Run the app, drive it with Playwright, and read screenshots/videos with read. Launch Chromium with --disable-dev-shm-usage (the sandbox /dev/shm is small).
